Eligibility of Tenderer : (1) The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in the construction works as Prime Contractor or
Subcontractor or Management Contractor shall be 10years. [Years counting backward from the date of publication of IFT in the
newspaper], (2) The minimum specific experience as a Prime Contractor or Subcontractor or Management Contractor in
construction works of at least 01 (one) contract(s) of similarnature,complexity and methods/construction technology successfully
completed within the last 10 (ten) years, each with a value of at least Tk. 330.00 crore. Similar nature,complexity
andmethods/construction technology means Construction of 4-lane Flyover with 2 Nos. Ramp/Loop, a total length of minimum 3.0
Km in city area successfullycompleted in a single contract. [Years counting backward from the date of publication of IFT in the
newspaper], (3) The required average annual construction turnover shall be greater than Tk 450 crore over the last 05 (five) years.
[Years counting backward from the date ofpublication of IFT in the newspaper], (4) The minimum amount of liquid assets or
working capital or credit facilities of the Tenderershall be Tk 80 crore. (5) The minimum Tender capacity shall be Taka 340 crore,
(6) Tenderers Must have up-to-date valid Licenses asapplicable, (7) Other required eligibility and conditions of the tenderer are
given in Tender Documents.
Brief Description of Works : Construction of Toll Plaza, 12 Nos. Ramp and its Related Works under the Project ”Construction of Elevated Expressway from
Lalkhan Bazar toSha-Amanat Airport in Chattogram City.”
Length and Width of 12 Nos. Ramp including other necessary works:
• Total Length = 4.7 Km (approximately), Width = 4.8m, 5.5m, 6.3m, 6.8m, 7.2m & 12.3m.
• 12 Nos. Ramps Construction, Road Work, Toll Plaza, Beautification Work (Water Fountain Construction), CC TV Camera with
Accessories, Flyover Administrative Monitoring Building Construction, Electrification Works etc. to Complete Construction of 12
Nos. Ramps and Toll Plaza of Elevated Expressway.
